description: This is the source code for the jQuery 1.12.4 library, a widely-used JavaScript library that simplifies DOM manipulation, event handling, and AJAX interactions. The file includes the core jQuery function, support methods, type checking, DOM traversal, and the Sizzle CSS selector engine for implementing complex selectors.

classes.name: jQuery.Event
classes.description: A custom event object that normalizes properties across browsers and provides methods to prevent default actions, stop propagation, and stop immediate propagation.

methods.name: jQuery
methods.description: Main function to select elements or create jQuery objects, acts as the constructor for a jQuery object.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Method to copy properties from source objects into target object, supports deep copy.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Iterates over objects and arrays, executing a callback for each item.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Determines if an object is a function.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if an object is an array.

methods.name: isWindow
methods.description: Checks if an object is the window object.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a value is numeric.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of an object as a string.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element contains another.

methods.name: setDocument
methods.description: Configures global document variables based on the provided document or element.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a CSS selector string into executable matcher functions, using Sizzle's internal caching.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Low-level selection function delegating to compiled Sizzle functions to perform CSS selector matching within a context.

methods.name: winnow
methods.description: Filters a set of elements based on a selector or a function, supporting logic for :not and simple string filters.

methods.name: createOptions
methods.description: Converts a space-separated string of options into an object with boolean properties for each option.

methods.name: returnTrue
methods.description: Function returning true, used as a default or placeholder callback.

methods.name: returnFalse
methods.description: Function returning false, used as a default or placeholder callback.

methods.name: safeActiveElement
methods.description: Returns the currently focused element in the document with exception safety, handling browser inconsistencies.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers event handlers on DOM elements with support for delegation, one-time handlers, and various event types and data.

methods.name: jQuery.event.add
methods.description: Adds an event listener to an element, managing internal event data and namespace support.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Attaches event handlers to elements, supporting delegation, multiple event types, and namespace features.

methods.name: one
methods.description: Attaches a one-time event handler to elements, executed at most once per element.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes event handlers from elements, supporting various signature patterns and namespaces.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers the specified event type on selected elements, optionally with additional data.

methods.name: triggerHandler
methods.description: Triggers an event on the first element matched, but only executes inline event handlers without bubbling.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an element, with optional copying of event handlers and data.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Gets or sets the HTML contents of elements, with internal optimizations for innerHTML.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Inserts content at the end of each element in the set.

methods.name: prepend
methods.description: Inserts content at the beginning of each element in the set.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts content before each element in the set.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts content after each element in the set.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Removes all child nodes of the set of matched elements.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes elements from the DOM, optionally filtering by selector.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Removes elements from the DOM but keeps data and event handlers.

methods.name: domManip
methods.description: Underlying utility function that handles DOM manipulation operations like appending, inserting, replacing, with script support.

methods.name: replaceWith
methods.description: Replaces each element in the set with new content.

methods.name: css
methods.description: Gets or sets CSS properties on elements, with support for hooks and normalization for browser differences.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows elements, supporting animation and toggling.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides elements, supporting animation and toggling.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles visibility of elements, supporting animation.

methods.name: val
methods.description: Gets or sets the value property of form elements, with hooks for special cases like select elements and checkboxes.

methods.name: attr
methods.description: Gets or sets attributes on DOM elements, with hooks and cross-browser fixes.

methods.name: prop
methods.description: Gets or sets DOM properties on elements, with hooks for certain properties and browser fixes.

methods.name: toggleClass
methods.description: Toggles class(es) on elements, with optional boolean parameter.

methods.name: hasClass
methods.description: Checks if any element has a specific class.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Attaches event handlers to elements, with support for delegation, namespace, and multiple event types.

methods.name: one
methods.description: Attaches a one-time event handler to elements.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers an event on selected elements.

methods.name: triggerHandler
methods.description: Triggers an inline event handler without bubbling.

methods.name: animate
methods.description: Performs custom animations on elements with support for multiple properties and easing.

methods.name: delay
methods.description: Delays execution in the animation queue.

methods.name: getJSON
methods.description: Performs a GET request expecting a JSON response, returns a jqXHR object.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Performs a GET request expecting a script response, executes it.
